frozenDecisions.tenantAuthority: authenticated device session plus server-side registry; request payload is never authoritative
frozenDecisions.delivery: at-least-once transport and exactly-once business effect
frozenDecisions.acceptance: server Inbox is durable before ACCEPTED or DUPLICATE acknowledgement
frozenDecisions.eventIdentity: same eventId and same hash is duplicate; same eventId and different hash blocks the device
frozenDecisions.unknown: retry or query the original event; never regenerate the business command
frozenDecisions.cursor: opaque stream-scoped monotonic token, committed atomically with local Inbox apply
frozenDecisions.migration: append-only SQLite V2 and MySQL V7/V8 with forward repair and N/N-1 compatibility
